The historical compatibility statement may be true, but the current install README presents an older version and obscures the installed package. Reproduce by reading README first paragraph and package.json version. Expected: compatibility copy identifies the current adapter or uses version-neutral range wording; preserve exact-tuple qualification limits. This is confirmed documentation friction, not an unsupported-host or runtime bug. No immediate runtime blocker; defer until a legitimate next package/evidence update rather than invalidating the sealed UI witness for a copy-only repair.
